subject: Request: Reduced Uptime & Latency Remedy for Medicorps pilot
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@medicorps.com>
To: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -0500
Subject: Pilot contract ask — uptime & latency remedy

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed with the latency and the routing controls. We're ready to move the pilot to procurement, but our legal and ops teams are pushing back on the proposed 99.95% uptime SLA and the service-credit schedule tied to latency spikes.

Specifically, for a 6-month pilot we need:
- uptime floor of 99.9% (instead of 99.95%)
- cap on aggregate service credits at 5% of monthly fees
- a faster remediation window for high-latency incidents (24 hours response / 72 hours mitigation)

They're also asking for a one-time onboarding discount to offset integration risk. Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept these nonstandard terms for the pilot?

Attached is our draft SOW with suggested language.

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Integrations, Medicorps
[attachment: Medicorps_SOW-v3.pdf (PDF, 245 KB)]

---
Medicorps procurement: procurement@medicorps.com
From: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@medicorps.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot contract ask — uptime & latency remedy

Hi Liam — thanks for sending the SOW. We're excited about Medicorps as a pilot customer.

Quick read: the asks you listed (99.9% uptime, 5% credit cap, accelerated remediation window, one-time onboarding discount) are nonstandard for our pilot terms but not impossible. Aditya from Deal Desk and Laura from Sales Ops are cc'd and will help scope the financial and operational tradeoffs.

What would help the internal review: a short paragraph on expected monthly tokens/throughput and which regions you'll serve in the pilot. Also confirm whether PHI will be routed through the service (I understand it's metadata-only for now).

I'll get this escalated for a decision today and circle back with an answer or a counterproposal.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Pilot contract ask — uptime & latency remedy (Deal Desk review)

Naomi / Laura —

Looping Deal Desk in — summary and requested approvals below. Please escalate to Marcus for exec sign-off if acceptable.

Summary of external asks (Medicorps):
- Accept 99.9% uptime for a 6-month pilot (standard is 99.95%)
- Cap aggregate service credits at 5% monthly fees (we typically use uncapped sliding scale)
- Narrow remediation SLAs for latency incidents (24/72 hours)
- One-time onboarding discount: 15% off first-month fees

Commercial impact: small pilot (estimated $12k/month run-rate) — revenue downside is minor, but the operational risk increases since 99.9% allows ~43 minutes/month downtime vs ~22 minutes at 99.95%.

Recommended approach for Marcus:
1) Approve 99.9% uptime for pilot only, with a mandatory post-pilot review and no long-term SLA change without product readouts.
2) Approve 5% cap on credits for pilot with a maximum $1,000 monthly cap.
3) Grant onboarding discount of 10% (counter to 15%) if Medicorps signs within 10 business days.
4) Require a higher severity reporting cadence and a single-point-of-contact from Medicorps ops.

Please see the attached internal risk note. Marcus — requesting exec OK to move forward on these constrained concessions for the pilot.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Deal Desk Analyst, Redwood Inference
From: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 13:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot contract ask — uptime & latency remedy (Deal Desk review)

Thanks team — I reviewed the recommendation. Given the small deal value and strategic fit (pilot with potential enterprise expansion), I approve moving forward with the following nonstandard terms for the 6-month pilot only:

- Uptime: 99.9% (pilot only). Must include explicit post-pilot performance review and right to revert to standard SLA for production.
- Service credits: cap at 5% of monthly fees, with an absolute cap of $1,000/month.
- Latency remediation: agree to 24h response / 72h mitigation target for incidents classified as "latency degradation" agreed in SOW.
- Discount: approve 10% one-time onboarding credit applied to month 1 invoice, conditional on signature within 10 business days.

Operational conditions before signing:
1) Medicorps must provide expected monthly throughput numbers and region footprint.
2) No PHI may be stored without a signed DPA and Private deployment plan. If PHI is in scope, escalate to Security (this must be a Private deployment).
3) Assign a single ops contact and weekly check-ins for first 30 days.

Aditya — please update the SOW with these clauses and run final redlines by Laura. Naomi — you can communicate these approvals to Liam and procurement; make clear these are pilot-only concessions.

-Markus
Marcus Lin
VP, Deal Operations, Redwood Inference
From: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@medicorps.com>, procurement@medicorps.com
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Pilot contract ask — uptime & latency remedy

Hi Liam — thanks, and appreciate the quick turnaround.

Good news: Redwood can accept the pilot terms with a few conditions. Approved pilot concessions (summary):
- Uptime: 99.9% for 6-month pilot only; post-pilot performance review required.
- Service credits: capped at 5% of monthly fees, with an absolute cap of $1,000/month.
- Latency remediation: 24-hour response / 72-hour mitigation target for agreed incident types.
- Onboarding discount: one-time 10% credit to the first invoice if signed within 10 business days.

Pre-signing checklist (required):
1) Please confirm expected monthly token/throughput and primary region(s) for the pilot.
2) Confirm scope of data — if PHI will be sent, we will need a DPA and Private deployment plan (not permitted under hosted pilot otherwise).
3) Medicorps to nominate a single ops contact and agree to weekly standups for the first 30 days.

I've attached the updated SOW (redlined) and the security questionnaire we discussed. Aditya will push final redlines into DocuSign once Medicorps confirms the checklist items.

If you agree, I'll have a countersigned deck out within 48 hours of your confirmation.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
